name: Zashikirou -Muku Otome Kyouiku-
source:
There is a small village deep in the mountain. Akitsugu is from a rich family, which has governed the area since old days. One day, a caretaker of his house takes her vacation and tells him to take care of "someone" confined in the basement. He just takes care of "someone" as being told, but he gradually wants to see the face.... When he finally opens the door, there is....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
深山里坐落着一座小村庄。秋次出身于一个自古以来统治此地的富裕家族。一天，家中的看护人准备休假，临行前嘱咐他照顾被关在地下室里的“某人”。秋次起初只是遵照吩咐照料“那个人”，却渐渐想看看对方的面容…当他终于打开门时，里面竟然是…

[摘自ErogeShop]
